mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mbc.create_time,'%Y-%m') yearMonth, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(mbc.quantity * ta.net_weight) / 1000, 0), 3) totalOutput FROM mes_building_complete mbc LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.id = mbc.product_id WHERE mbc.task_type_enum = 2 AND mbc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbc.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY yearMonth ORDER BY yearMonth

SELECT ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(mbc.quantity * ta.net_weight) / 1000, 0), 3) AS projectOutput FROM mes_building_complete mbc LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.id = mbc.product_id WHERE mbc.task_type_enum = 2 AND mbc.project_id = #{projectId} AND mbc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(mbc.create_time,'%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT( mbcl.create_time, '%Y-%m' ) yearMonth, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(mbcl.actual_weight) / 1000, 0), 3) AS totalOutput FROM mes_building_cargo_list mbcl WHERE mbcl.project_id = #{projectId} AND mbcl.status IN (4, 8) AND delivery_status = 1 AND mbcl.bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY yearMonth ORDER BY yearMonth

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(prpc.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS yearMonth, COALESCE(SUM(prpc.total_amount), 0) AS scrapAmountMoney, COALESCE(SUM(prpc.quantity * COALESCE(cargo_product.net_weight, artifact.net_weight)) / 1000, 0) AS scrapAmount FROM project_return_product_child prpc LEFT JOIN mes_building_cargo_list_product_link cargo_product ON prpc.status = 1 AND cargo_product.id = prpc.cargo_link_id AND cargo_product.product_id = prpc.product_id AND cargo_product.product_type = prpc.product_type LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON prpc.product_type = 2 AND artifact.id = prpc.product_id AND artifact.project_id = prpc.project_id WHERE prpc.handle_method = 3 AND prpc.project_id = #{projectId} AND prpc.bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY yearMonth ORDER BY yearMonth

SELECT DATE_FORMAT( mbcl.create_time, '%Y-%m' ) AS yearMonth, ROUND(SUM( mbcl.actual_weight ) / 1000, 3) AS transportAmount,
ROUND(SUM(mbcl.total_price), 2) AS costMonthTotal, ROUND(SUM(mbcl.total_price ) * 1000 / SUM(mbcl.actual_weight), 2) AS transportCostPerTon
ROUND(SUM(mbcl.total_price * 100 / (100 + sp.tax)), 2) AS costMonthTotal, ROUND(SUM(mbcl.total_price * 100 / (100 + sp.tax)) * 1000 / SUM(mbcl.actual_weight), 2) AS transportCostPerTon
FROM mes_building_cargo_list mbcl LEFT JOIN mes_building_supplier_price AS sp ON mbcl.supplier_price_id = sp.id WHERE mbcl.STATUS IN (4, 8) AND mbcl.project_id = #{projectId} AND mbcl.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbcl.total_price != 0 GROUP BY yearMonth

SELECT months.yearMonth, IFNULL( SUM( mbcl.actual_weight ), 0 ) AS transportAmount, IFNULL( SUM( mbcl.total_price ), 0 ) AS costMonthTotal FROM (${yearMonthBetweenDates}) AS months LEFT JOIN mes_building_cargo_list mbcl ON DATE_FORMAT( mbcl.create_time, '%Y-%m' ) = months.yearMonth AND (mbcl.STATUS = 4 OR mbcl.STATUS = 8) AND mbcl.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY months.yearMonth
select id from sys_branch_company where id = (select contract_sign_body_id from contract_project where id = #{projectId})

SELECT ym_t.`year_month`, ROUND(t.total_yield, 5) AS total_yield, ROUND(p_t.yield, 5) AS project_yield, ROUND(ROUND(p_t.yield, 5) / ROUND(t.total_yield, 5), 2) AS proportion, ROUND(fee.total_fee, 2) AS total_fee, ROUND(fee.total_fee * ROUND(ROUND(p_t.yield, 5) / ROUND(t.total_yield, 5), 2), 2) AS amortization_amount FROM (
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(#{i}, '%Y-%m') AS `year_month`
) ym_t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mbc.in_year_month_date AS `year_month`, (SUM(mbc.quantity * ta.net_weight) / 1000) AS total_yield FROM mes_building_complete mbc LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND cp.id = mbc.project_id LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.id = mbc.product_id AND mbc.task_type_enum = 2 WHERE mbc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbc.task_type_enum = 2
GROUP BY mbc.in_year_month_date ) t ON t.year_month = ym_t.year_month LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mbc.in_year_month_date AS `year_month`, (SUM(mbc.quantity * ta.net_weight) / 1000) AS yield FROM mes_building_complete mbc LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND cp.id = mbc.project_id LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND ta.id = mbc.product_id AND mbc.task_type_enum = 2 WHERE mbc.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mbc.task_type_enum = 2 AND mbc.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY mbc.in_year_month_date ) p_t ON ym_t.`year_month` = p_t.`year_month` LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(mtw.report_date, '%Y-%m') AS `year_month`, SUM(mtw.calculate_amount) AS total_fee FROM mes_temp_work mtw WHERE mtw.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND mtw.project_id IS NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(mtw.report_date, '%Y-%m') ) fee ON fee.year_month = ym_t.`year_month`
